call_points.text: Installed capacity reached over 1.62 GW with 4.64 GW under work-in-progress.
Net worth increased to ₹3,273 crores in FY26 from ₹2,630 crores in FY25.
Received inter-state trading licence from CERC and intra-state licence from GERC, enabling pan-India power market participation.
FY26 EBITDA margin was 37% against 33% in FY25; Q4FY26 margin was 38% against 29%.
Group targets 10+ GW by 2030; no FY27 financial guidance is given in the presentation.
Land bank stood at 7,210 acres and power evacuation capacity at 3,599 MW at March 2026.

operating_notes.text: Installed India's first Make in India 4.2 MW wind turbine (4.2M160) by Senvion India in South Gujarat.
Captive power project sales were ₹715 Cr in Q4FY26, 90% of revenue.
Debt-equity ratio rose to 1.49 at March 2026 from 0.46 a year earlier.
Inventory turnover ratio (annualised) was 263 days in Q4FY26 against 125 days in Q4FY25.
IPP unit generation was 41.0 crore units in FY26 against 24.9 crore units in FY25.
IPP portfolio 2.57 GWp: 0.96 GWp energised, 1.61 GWp under execution; 733 MW has PPA and financial closure, 445 MW PPA with financial closure in progress, 420 MW PPA execution in progress.
Land bank 7,210 acres and power evacuation capacity 3,599 MW at March 2026; portfolio hybrid CUF 50.6% on AC basis in FY26.
Received ₹118.75 Cr (25% upfront) from 1.01 crore convertible warrants issued at ₹470.30 each, fully utilized as of March 31, 2026.
Received NOAs for 500 MW Solar BOS Project in Bikaner, Rajasthan, with an aggregate contract value of ₹621 crore excluding GST.
Installed capacity stood at over 1.62 GW with WIP capacity of over 4.64 GW as of March 31, 2026.
Sun Drops Energia holds 88.37% in DEK and Mavericks Green Energy Limited.

timeline.summary: On April 24, 2026, KPI Green Energy announced the incorporation of a wholly owned subsidiary, KPGC Global Corporation IFSC Private Limited, in GIFT City with a capital of ₹2 Cr.
KPI Group installed India's first Make in India 4.2 MW wind turbine in South Gujarat on May 5, 2026.
Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹795.81 Cr (+39.8% YoY), net profit to shareholders ₹145.29 Cr (+46.6% YoY).
On May 6, 2026, KPI Green's FY26 earnings presentation reported revenue up 55% to ₹2,696 Cr and PAT up 57% to ₹509 Cr, with the IPP portfolio at 2.57 GWp of which 0.96 GWp is energised.
On May 6, 2026, KPI Green Energy submitted the Monitoring Agency Report showing full utilization of the ₹118.75 Cr upfront proceeds from its ₹475 Cr warrant preferential issue.
On May 8, 2026, KPI Green Energy announced the receipt of NOAs from NTPC Renewable Energy for a 500 MW solar BOS project in Bikaner, Rajasthan, valued at ₹621 Cr.
Mohmed Sohil Yusuf Dabhoya, Whole Time Director, submitted the audio recording of the Q4FY26 earnings conference call on May 12, 2026, available on the company’s website.
On May 15, 2026, KPI Green Energy announced the appointment of Rajesh Shrivastava as Whole Time Director and the re-appointment of Venu Birappa as Independent Director.
On May 12, 2026, KPI Green Energy held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call, reporting total income of ₹2,742 Cr and PAT of ₹509 Cr for FY26.
KPI Green Energy subsidiary signs 120 MW / 240 MWh standalone BESS purchase agreement with GUVNL
Faruk G. Patel, as Promoter/Chairman & Managing Director, declared no new encumbrances on KPI Green Energy shares for FY2025-26 on April 04, 2026.
KPI Green Energy's material subsidiary Sun Drops Energia acquired an 88.37% stake in DMGEL.
